evidence.claim: Laser costruisce macchine e forni industriali per la produzione automatica di biscotti, pane e pasticceria con produzione tutta italiana in provincia di Verona.
evidence.quote: LASER srl is able to offer a wide range of industrial machines and ovens for the automatic production of all types of biscuits, bread, pastry. || A completely Italian production, with three locations in the Province of Verona (Italy): || Laser srl has been successfully operating for over twenty five years in the manufacture of machinery and systems for the confectionery and bakery products industry.
